title: Integrated Adaptive Competitive Strategy
decision: PASS -- Variant D (Phase 3.3) remains the canonical adaptive mechanism. No new candidate promoted. Reported as an informative null/partial result, per the brief's explicit allowance.

controls.control_A_planner_v1: Frozen, unmodified. 30/30 exact byte-for-byte control reproduction re-verified this phase (results/phase3_1/control_reproduction/).
controls.control_B_variant_D: Frozen (agents/phase3_3/interventions.py unmodified). 15/15 exact byte-for-byte reproduction of its own Phase 3.3 reference results re-verified independently this phase.
controls.control_C_detection_only: Variant B (intervention_fn=None) remains inert by construction and by regression test (scripts/phase3_3_regression_tests.py::test_detection_only_is_inert, still passing).

failure_forensics.root_cause: Self-inflicted STRAWBERRY price crash: Variant D concentrates 100% of MELON's freed portfolio share into the single highest-ranked substitute crop (STRAWBERRY), which has the smallest market depth (T=100) of any of the 5 crops. Production volume is nearly identical between wins and losses (96-110 units); the difference is entirely in realized sell PRICE ($126-204 in losses vs $259-279 in wins).
failure_forensics.taxonomy: self_inflicted_narrow_market_price_crash (applies to all 5 known losses; no UNKNOWN-category losses identified)

Candidate_C_diversified_substitution.mechanism: split MELON's freed share across top-2 ranked non-MELON crops instead of 1
Candidate_C_diversified_substitution.result: REJECTED -- 0/15 wins on the full expansion_oriented battery (vs Variant D's 10/15), uniformly worse. TOMATO (the #2 crop) is ~4.7x weaker than STRAWBERRY by economic_model.crop_production_value(), so diversification traded away far more mean value than it recovered in reduced price-impact variance.

Candidate_E_partial_melon_retention.mechanism: hard-coded 50/50 MELON+STRAWBERRY split instead of 100% redirection
Candidate_E_partial_melon_retention.result: REJECTED -- 8/15 wins on the full battery (vs Variant D's 10/15). Flips 3 of Variant D's wins into losses while only flipping 1 of its losses into a win; net negative. Retaining MELON exposure reintroduces the market-crash risk Variant D had already eliminated.

supporting_analyses.regime_stability: expansion_oriented classified with the SAME predicted class at all 9 checkpoints in all 15 seeds -- zero regime transitions observed (results/phase3_4/regime_analysis/regime_stability.json)
supporting_analyses.detection_confidence: ~1.0 at the turn-24 detection point in both wins and losses -- confidence does not discriminate outcome; the residual losses are an allocation problem, not a detection problem (results/phase3_4/regime_analysis/detection_confidence_analysis.json)
supporting_analyses.generalization: 'No intervention needed' confirmed for all 6 non-expansion_oriented archetypes -- detector never activates (0 activations), Variant D byte-identical to the Planner v1 control on every common seed (results/phase3_4/market_analysis/generalization_analysis.json)
supporting_analyses.market_impact_chain: 6-step causal chain from opponent land/crop config through shared-market price collapse to portfolio exposure to outcome, extended to the second-order self-inflicted STRAWBERRY crash (results/phase3_4/market_analysis/market_impact_chain.json)
supporting_analyses.subadditivity: Mechanism (shared, finite daily labor-time budget across simultaneously-committed candidates) EXPERIMENTALLY_VALIDATED via a fresh 3-seed re-run showing COW/SHEEP output imbalance consistent with P26-001; no numeric correction derived (would require an evaluator.py redesign, out of Phase 3.4 scope) (results/phase3_4/subadditivity_analysis/summary.json)
supporting_analyses.switching_cost_and_temporal_response: Not cleanly isolated (confounded with crop-dependent labor/animal decisions); directionally, earlier intervention (turn 0) does not show a consistent benefit over the current turn-24 timing and often hurts (results/phase3_4/switching_analysis/summary.json)

regression_tests: 65/65 pre-existing tests (Phase 2.6 + 3.1 + 3.2 + 3.3) still passing, plus 14/14 new Phase 3.4 tests -- 79/79 total (scripts/phase3_4_regression_tests.py)
control_reproduction: Planner v1: 30/30 exact matches. Variant D: 15/15 exact matches against its own Phase 3.3 reference. Frozen file hashes unchanged.
reason_not_promoted: Both new candidates, each specifically targeting the diagnosed failure mode, underperformed Variant D on the full 15-seed expansion_oriented battery when measured honestly (not just on the known-losing subset). No candidate satisfies the brief's promotion criteria (must strictly dominate or clearly outperform Variant D).
